name: gym-gym
description: 纯本地的健身训练记录 PWA · 零后端零账号 · iPhone 添加到主屏幕即用 · A local-first gym tracker PWA (React + Zustand, no backend)

paragraphs: A local-first gym & body-weight tracker PWA — log every set, rest-timer built in, PRs detected automatically. Zero backend, zero accounts: your data never leaves your phone.
Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen → full-screen app → start training
features: 📅 Weekly plan / rotation: assign a routine to each weekday, or run a rotation (A → B → C → A) that follows whatever you actually did; Home shows today's session and, on rest days, when the next one is

📈 Progression engine: linear and double-progression schemes auto-advance your working weights — hit all target reps → load goes up; miss → it doesn't; stall twice → deload. Every target shows why it is that number…
🔗 Supersets: pair adjacent exercises in the routine editor; the workout flags the pair and the rest-timer tells you to alternate
👆 Swipe a set: left to delete, right to copy — plus per-exercise rest override right on the workout screen

🏋️ Guided sessions: start from a preset routine (push / pull / legs / full-body) or a blank workout; 115 built-in exercises across 8 muscle groups and 5 equipment types, with equipment filters and search — plus one-tap…

whatItDoes.text: A local-first gym & body-weight tracker PWA — log every set, rest-timer built in, PRs detected automatically. Zero backend, zero accounts: your data never leaves your phone.

requirements.text: 🔒 Local-only: no backend, no accounts, no telemetry — the entire state is one JSON document in localStorage
No account means no automatic transfer — that is the trade-off of being server-free
